liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (6 reviews): Starts quietly and reaches verse one fast, then a long stretch of bells, windy cymbals and jungle-like noises; Sustained feedback makes Garcia sound like a cello, leading into structured chord sequences like a series of mini-songs [14][17][19][20][23][24]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer finds this China Cat mediocre and suggests dropping it, along with Doin' That Rag, to save a disc [16]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Reviewer thought the band might completely lose it several times during Morning Dew; calls the first disc fumbling [18]
- **Easy Wind** (1 review): Song falls apart, but Pigpen keeps singing in time; Garcia then enters later with an intense, talking-guitar solo that revives it [22]
- **Saint Stephen** (1 review): Band comes unhinged as Jerry plays peals of feedback where the solo should be [23]

## The recordings

- **gd69-08-30.sbd.barbella.8594.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 9 songs; 88 min; rated 4.15/5 by 26 [1]. Said about its sound: Stereo audio with an excellent mix [22]
- **gd1969-08-30.122267.upg.sbd.tobin.flac16**: soundboard; 9 songs; 88 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1969-08-30.122268.dts.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 5 songs; 54 min [4]
- **gd1969-08-30.153184.mtx.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 5 songs; 54 min [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer suggests the intimate setting before family and friends inspired the band's adventurous exploring [19]
- Crowd is hushed and respectful during the first verse of Dark Star, with unusually clear silence on tape [21]
- Reviewer thinks this may be the only St. Stephen where Garcia doesn't play the solo [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-08-30.sbd.barbella.8594.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Seth Kaplan and Steve Barbella; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Less hiss than the earlier circulating soundboard cassette > DAT > CDR copy; discs supplied by Seth Kaplan; The newer CDs come from Latvala's cassette copy of master reels; the cassette flips about 11 minutes into Dark Star [1]
- **gd1969-08-30.122267.upg.sbd.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Master Soundboard Reel > Cass > DAT > CD; via Seth Kaplan; Seeded to etree by Steve Barbella - Patched and Tagged by Kevin Tobin [3]. Also: Mixed by an archive.org user; FLAC conversion made 8 October 2012 by Trader Little Helper [3]
- **gd1969-08-30.122268.dts.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix ; SBD (shn id 8594) Master Soundboard Reel > Cass > DAT > CD; via Seth Kaplan; Seeded to etree by Steve Barbella + AUD1 (shn id 122231)… [4]. Also: Mixed by an archive.org user as a DTS 5.1 surround recording on a regular audio CD; FLAC conversion October 2012 [4]
- **gd1969-08-30.153184.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) [6]. Also: Mix by an archive.org user covering Dark Star onward; FLAC conversion made 30 August 2021 [6]
